%CAR+ (FC-CAR, % of CD3+) is controlled mainly by transduction MOI and by the functional titer of the vector lot. Your chain shows two problems. The open deviation on low %CAR+ most likely has the wrong root cause, and the open MOI change control conflicts with validated limits.

I used no direct spec item for %CAR+ itself. `val_spec_item` only holds system-level URS/CS requirements, so the chain below runs through risks, SOPs, protocols and QC data.

## 1. Process parameters that drive it

| Parameter | Limit / evidence | Records |
|---|---|---|
| **Transduction MOI** (dominant driver) | PPQ-001 CPP 1 limit is 4.0–6.0 TU/cell. In the DoE-MOI runs (3 per level), mean %CAR+ was 22% at MOI 2.5, 38.8% at 5, 65.5% at 10 and 76.3% at 15. | PPQ-001 crit 1, DOE-MOI-01/02/03 |
| **Vector lot functional titer and storage** | The EBR vector volume is MOI × cells ÷ CoA titer. I recomputed this for PD26-001 and PD26-014 and it matches the recorded volumes. | LV25-104, LV25-118, LV26-007, LV26-021 |
| **Time from activation to transduction** | The limit is 20–30 h (crit 5). The only two out-of-window runs, both at 18–18.6 h, were lower: PD26-032 gave 27.6% and PD26-047 gave 34.7%, against about 38–44% in-window. | FM-08, SOP-MFG-104 |
| Seeding density, culture duration, apheresis CD3% and hold time | Weak or no effect on %CAR+ in the data. | crit 2 and 4 |

## 2. Risks that threaten it (pFMEA RA-PFMEA-001, v2.0 approved 2026-04-28)
- **FM-06**, MOI below target (RPN 128, HIGH, the top pFMEA risk). Its controls are "EBR calculation; CoA titer". Its `assurance_approach` is empty.
- **FM-07**, vector held above –70 °C. It impacts "Transduction efficiency; VCN" (RPN 96, HIGH).
- **FM-08**, transduction outside 20–30 h. It lists "TE", which I read as transduction efficiency.
- **FM-15**, OOS result not flagged (RPN 80, HIGH). It lists %CAR+ among its CQAs.
- **FM-11 and FM-12** affect "CAR+ viable cell dose" rather than %CAR+ itself.
- **FM-05**, MOI above target, is the paired risk. It affects VCN, not %CAR+.

## 3. Controls and test evidence, with gaps

| Risk | Control | Test evidence | Gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| FM-06 | URS-EBR-007 / CS-EBR-02 (vector volume calculation) and SOP-MFG-104 | TC-OQ-EBR-04, tested 2.5–10 TU/cell, PASS (TX-0083) | No control re-verifies titer after storage. The EBR keeps using the CoA titer, e.g. 104e6 TU/mL for LV25-118 after the freezer failure. |
| FM-05 (and FM-06's range side) | URS-EBR-009 / CS-EBR-03 (MOI 4.0–6.0 hard stop) | **No test case verifies it.** | No test case verifies it, and FM-06 is not linked to it. |
| FM-07 | URS-ULT-001/002, URS-EMS-014, SOP-MAT-401 | TC-OQ-ULT-01/02 and TC-PQ-ULT-01 PASS | TC-OQ-EMS-04 (escalation within 15 min) passed on 2026-01-20. CC-26-011 then rebuilt the paging and escalation configuration on 2026-03-12 to 16 with "no re-testing required". |
| FM-08 | SOP-MFG-104 and a batch record timing check | None | No system control or test. |
| FM-15 | URS-LIMS-002/003 → CS-LIMS-02/01 | TC-OQ-LIMS-02/03 PASS (TX-0074, TX-0075) | `CHAR` results below 20% carry no pass/fail flag (e.g. PD26-024 to 027). |

FM-07 carries an occurrence rating of 2. The pFMEA was approved on 2026-04-28, eight days after the freezer failure (section 6), and the rating was not changed.

## 4. How it is measured and validated
- **Method:** AM-FC-CAR, CAR expression by flow cytometry, QC code FC-CAR, status VALIDATED. The validated range is 5–90 % of CD3+. The SOP is SOP-QC-202 v2.0.
- **Validation:** AMV-FC-CAR-01 (report approved). It has one test case, TC-AMV-CAR-01 (accuracy, precision, range), executed 2026-03-20 as TX-0086, PASS.
- **Specification:** at least 20 % of CD3+. It is a release criterion for PPQ (PPQ-001 crit 8, CQA).

## 5. PPQ performance (PPQ-001, status "EXECUTION COMPLETE – REPORT PENDING")
All five batches passed crit 8, with MOI 5.0, 21.9–23.7 h to transduction and seeding density 0.47–0.54 in range.

| Batch | %CAR+ | Vector lot |
|---|---|---|
| PPQ26-01 | 44.6 | LV26-007 |
| PPQ26-02 | 39.2 | LV26-007 |
| PPQ26-03 | 36.1 | LV26-007 |
| PPQ26-04 | 38.9 | LV26-021 |
| PPQ26-05 | 37.3 | LV26-021 |

None of the PPQ batches used the compromised lot LV25-118. Related PPQ deviations are DEV-26-033 (harvest viability, PPQ26-02) and DEV-26-041 (tubing leak, PPQ26-05, still open). Neither affects %CAR+.

## 6. Related deviations and what connects them
**DEV-26-027** (open, minor) covers low %CAR+ in ENG26-01 and ENG26-02. Its stated root cause is donor variability and low apheresis CD3%. The data do not support that:
- On MOI-5 runs, lot LV25-118 gave a mean of 38.2% (n=10) before 2026-04-21 and 15.7% (n=7, range 11.9–19.8) after.
- The post-April runs include PD26-024 to 027 and ENG26-01 to 03. The same lot gave a mean of 38.2% on 10 earlier runs.
- Donor HD-0118 gave 41.3% on PD26-022 and about 16% on PD26-026/027. The same donor gave 44.6% on PPQ26-01 with a new vector lot.
- Apheresis CD3% for ENG26-01/02/03 was 65.3, 63.8 and 50.9, which is not low. Low-CD3 runs on good vector still gave about 37%.
- ENG26-03 (13.9%) is also below 20% but is not named in the deviation.

The more likely cause is vector titer loss in **DEV-26-021** (major, closed 2026-05-12):
- The FRZ-80-02 compressor failed on 2026-04-20. The alarm started at 03:20 and was acknowledged at 14:40 by warehouse staff, about 11 h 20 min later. The requirement in URS-EMS-014 is 15 minutes, 24/7.
- LV25-118 was stored in FRZ-80-02 (it is still listed there in `material_lot`). The `FRZ8002.TEMP.PV` tag shows the chamber passed –65 °C at about 04:00–05:00 and reached –36 °C at the 15:30 relocation. It then warmed to –10 °C by 04-23 (temperature in °C).
- The deviation relied on a supplier statement of ≤ –65 °C and put no lots on hold. No functional re-titer was done.
- The deviation did not examine the escalation delay, even though CC-26-011 had changed that configuration without re-testing.

**What connects them:**
- CC-26-011 (EMS paging change) → CS-EMS-03 → URS-EMS-014 → FM-07 → FRZ-80-02 excursion (EV-26-0009, DEV-26-021, CAPA-26-008, CC-26-014) → vector lot LV25-118 → low %CAR+ in PD26-024 to 027 and ENG26-01 to 03 → DEV-26-027.
- CAPA-26-016 (open, evaluate a minimum CD3% at apheresis receipt) follows the donor hypothesis and therefore probably targets the wrong cause.
- **CC-26-022** (open, impact assessment stage) proposes raising MOI from 5.0 to 8.0 TU/cell "to improve %CAR+". It conflicts with several controls:
  - PPQ-001 CPP 1 (4.0–6.0).
  - The EBR hard stop (URS-EBR-009 / CS-EBR-03), which is untested.
  - The FM-05 / VCN risk. VCN per CAR+ cell rose to 4.7–4.99 at MOI 15, against a limit of 5.
  - Its impact assessment lists only SOP-MFG-104, and omits the PPQ, the pFMEA and the EBR configuration.
  - At MOI 5 with a good vector lot, %CAR+ is already about 38%, well above 20%.

content.text:
%CAR+ (FC-CAR, % of CD3+) is controlled mainly by transduction MOI and by the functional titer of the vector lot. Your chain shows two problems. The open deviation on low %CAR+ most likely has the wrong root cause, and the open MOI change control conflicts with validated limits.

I used no direct spec item for %CAR+ itself. `val_spec_item` only holds system-level URS/CS requirements, so the chain below runs through risks, SOPs, protocols and QC data.

## 1. Process parameters that drive it

| Parameter | Limit / evidence | Records |
|---|---|---|
| **Transduction MOI** (dominant driver) | PPQ-001 CPP 1 limit is 4.0–6.0 TU/cell. In the DoE-MOI runs (3 per level), mean %CAR+ was 22% at MOI 2.5, 38.8% at 5, 65.5% at 10 and 76.3% at 15. | PPQ-001 crit 1, DOE-MOI-01/02/03 |
| **Vector lot functional titer and storage** | The EBR vector volume is MOI × cells ÷ CoA titer. I recomputed this for PD26-001 and PD26-014 and it matches the recorded volumes. | LV25-104, LV25-118, LV26-007, LV26-021 |
| **Time from activation to transduction** | The limit is 20–30 h (crit 5). The only two out-of-window runs, both at 18–18.6 h, were lower: PD26-032 gave 27.6% and PD26-047 gave 34.7%, against about 38–44% in-window. | FM-08, SOP-MFG-104 |
| Seeding density, culture duration, apheresis CD3% and hold time | Weak or no effect on %CAR+ in the data. | crit 2 and 4 |

## 2. Risks that threaten it (pFMEA RA-PFMEA-001, v2.0 approved 2026-04-28)
- **FM-06**, MOI below target (RPN 128, HIGH, the top pFMEA risk). Its controls are "EBR calculation; CoA titer". Its `assurance_approach` is empty.
- **FM-07**, vector held above –70 °C. It impacts "Transduction efficiency; VCN" (RPN 96, HIGH).
- **FM-08**, transduction outside 20–30 h. It lists "TE", which I read as transduction efficiency.
- **FM-15**, OOS result not flagged (RPN 80, HIGH). It lists %CAR+ among its CQAs.
- **FM-11 and FM-12** affect "CAR+ viable cell dose" rather than %CAR+ itself.
- **FM-05**, MOI above target, is the paired risk. It affects VCN, not %CAR+.

## 3. Controls and test evidence, with gaps

| Risk | Control | Test evidence | Gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| FM-06 | URS-EBR-007 / CS-EBR-02 (vector volume calculation) and SOP-MFG-104 | TC-OQ-EBR-04, tested 2.5–10 TU/cell, PASS (TX-0083) | No control re-verifies titer after storage. The EBR keeps using the CoA titer, e.g. 104e6 TU/mL for LV25-118 after the freezer failure. |
| FM-05 (and FM-06's range side) | URS-EBR-009 / CS-EBR-03 (MOI 4.0–6.0 hard stop) | **No test case verifies it.** | No test case verifies it, and FM-06 is not linked to it. |
| FM-07 | URS-ULT-001/002, URS-EMS-014, SOP-MAT-401 | TC-OQ-ULT-01/02 and TC-PQ-ULT-01 PASS | TC-OQ-EMS-04 (escalation within 15 min) passed on 2026-01-20. CC-26-011 then rebuilt the paging and escalation configuration on 2026-03-12 to 16 with "no re-testing required". |
| FM-08 | SOP-MFG-104 and a batch record timing check | None | No system control or test. |
| FM-15 | URS-LIMS-002/003 → CS-LIMS-02/01 | TC-OQ-LIMS-02/03 PASS (TX-0074, TX-0075) | `CHAR` results below 20% carry no pass/fail flag (e.g. PD26-024 to 027). |

FM-07 carries an occurrence rating of 2. The pFMEA was approved on 2026-04-28, eight days after the freezer failure (section 6), and the rating was not changed.

## 4. How it is measured and validated
- **Method:** AM-FC-CAR, CAR expression by flow cytometry, QC code FC-CAR, status VALIDATED. The validated range is 5–90 % of CD3+. The SOP is SOP-QC-202 v2.0.
- **Validation:** AMV-FC-CAR-01 (report approved). It has one test case, TC-AMV-CAR-01 (accuracy, precision, range), executed 2026-03-20 as TX-0086, PASS.
- **Specification:** at least 20 % of CD3+. It is a release criterion for PPQ (PPQ-001 crit 8, CQA).

## 5. PPQ performance (PPQ-001, status "EXECUTION COMPLETE – REPORT PENDING")
All five batches passed crit 8, with MOI 5.0, 21.9–23.7 h to transduction and seeding density 0.47–0.54 in range.

| Batch | %CAR+ | Vector lot |
|---|---|---|
| PPQ26-01 | 44.6 | LV26-007 |
| PPQ26-02 | 39.2 | LV26-007 |
| PPQ26-03 | 36.1 | LV26-007 |
| PPQ26-04 | 38.9 | LV26-021 |
| PPQ26-05 | 37.3 | LV26-021 |

None of the PPQ batches used the compromised lot LV25-118. Related PPQ deviations are DEV-26-033 (harvest viability, PPQ26-02) and DEV-26-041 (tubing leak, PPQ26-05, still open). Neither affects %CAR+.

## 6. Related deviations and what connects them
**DEV-26-027** (open, minor) covers low %CAR+ in ENG26-01 and ENG26-02. Its stated root cause is donor variability and low apheresis CD3%. The data do not support that:
- On MOI-5 runs, lot LV25-118 gave a mean of 38.2% (n=10) before 2026-04-21 and 15.7% (n=7, range 11.9–19.8) after.
- The post-April runs include PD26-024 to 027 and ENG26-01 to 03. The same lot gave a mean of 38.2% on 10 earlier runs.
- Donor HD-0118 gave 41.3% on PD26-022 and about 16% on PD26-026/027. The same donor gave 44.6% on PPQ26-01 with a new vector lot.
- Apheresis CD3% for ENG26-01/02/03 was 65.3, 63.8 and 50.9, which is not low. Low-CD3 runs on good vector still gave about 37%.
- ENG26-03 (13.9%) is also below 20% but is not named in the deviation.

The more likely cause is vector titer loss in **DEV-26-021** (major, closed 2026-05-12):
- The FRZ-80-02 compressor failed on 2026-04-20. The alarm started at 03:20 and was acknowledged at 14:40 by warehouse staff, about 11 h 20 min later. The requirement in URS-EMS-014 is 15 minutes, 24/7.
- LV25-118 was stored in FRZ-80-02 (it is still listed there in `material_lot`). The `FRZ8002.TEMP.PV` tag shows the chamber passed –65 °C at about 04:00–05:00 and reached –36 °C at the 15:30 relocation. It then warmed to –10 °C by 04-23 (temperature in °C).
- The deviation relied on a supplier statement of ≤ –65 °C and put no lots on hold. No functional re-titer was done.
- The deviation did not examine the escalation delay, even though CC-26-011 had changed that configuration without re-testing.

**What connects them:**
- CC-26-011 (EMS paging change) → CS-EMS-03 → URS-EMS-014 → FM-07 → FRZ-80-02 excursion (EV-26-0009, DEV-26-021, CAPA-26-008, CC-26-014) → vector lot LV25-118 → low %CAR+ in PD26-024 to 027 and ENG26-01 to 03 → DEV-26-027.
- CAPA-26-016 (open, evaluate a minimum CD3% at apheresis receipt) follows the donor hypothesis and therefore probably targets the wrong cause.
- **CC-26-022** (open, impact assessment stage) proposes raising MOI from 5.0 to 8.0 TU/cell "to improve %CAR+". It conflicts with several controls:
  - PPQ-001 CPP 1 (4.0–6.0).
  - The EBR hard stop (URS-EBR-009 / CS-EBR-03), which is untested.
  - The FM-05 / VCN risk. VCN per CAR+ cell rose to 4.7–4.99 at MOI 15, against a limit of 5.
  - Its impact assessment lists only SOP-MFG-104, and omits the PPQ, the pFMEA and the EBR configuration.
  - At MOI 5 with a good vector lot, %CAR+ is already about 38%, well above 20%.
